alt.en: A large teal tool tile with a gear icon stands at the center of a gray floor. A dashed orange arrow runs to it from an open laptop showing lines of code on the left, and a dotted violet line joins it to a closed violet book lying on the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一块带齿轮图标的青绿色大工具牌。左侧一台打开的笔记本电脑显示代码，一条橙色虚线箭头从它指向工具牌；一条紫色点线把工具牌连到右侧平放的紫色书本。

caption.en: Illustration: a laptop sends model output to a tool-calling parser, drawn as a tool tile, whose results are compared with a book of reviewed expected outputs. It does not depict NVIDIA's parsers or test corpus, and it does not depict a tested deployment.
caption.zh: 示意图：笔记本电脑把模型输出送入以工具牌表示的工具调用解析器，解析结果再与一本经审阅的预期输出对照。图中并非 NVIDIA 的解析器或测试语料库，也不代表任何经过测试的部署。
